The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance

IT is hereby notified that the names of the members returned to each local authority specified in Column II of the Schedule hereto, and located within the administrative districts indicated in Column I of the said Schedule, are as set out below. It is further notified that these names are in addition to those published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2444/60 dated 11.07.2025, Gazette Extraordinary No. 2444/02 dated 07.07.2025, Gazette Extraordinary No. 2443/60 dated 04.07.2025, Gazette Extraordinary No. 2442/60 dated 27.06.2025, Gazette Extraordinary No. 2441/55 dated 20.06.2025, Gazette Extraordinary No. 2440/25 dated 13.06.2025, Gazette Extraordinary No. 2439/65 dated 06.06.2025 and in the Gazette Extraordinary notifications referred thereto, bearing numbers 2438/66, 2438/67, 2438/69, 2438/70, 2438/71, 2438/72. 2438/80, 2438/81, 2438/83, 2438/84, 2438/87, 2438/88, 2438/89, and 2438/90 dated 31.05.2025 and in the Gazette Extraordinary notifications No. 2438/68, 2438/74 and 2438/85 dated 31.05.2025.
R.M.A.L. Rathnayake, M.A.P.C. Perera, Ameer Faaiz, Chairman, Member, Member, Election Commission. Election Commission. Election Commission.
A. Shanmuganathan, Prof. Lakshman Dissanayake, Member, Member, Election Commission. Election Commission. Election Commissions Office,Sarana Mawatha,Rajagiriya,01st August, 2025.
